text: {"features":[{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter speaks to Google's Information Security Engineering role rather than to software jobs in general.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter names the role or company but is otherwise generic enough that it could fit many engineering applications."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some targeting to security engineering or Google but connects the applicant to only a small part of the posted work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is clearly written for this kind of security engineering role and references at least one relevant responsibility or theme from the posting."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter aligns past work to several posted responsibilities such as Go back ends, Python automation, AI agents, or vulnerability handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter feels custom-written for this exact opening, precisely connecting the applicant's background to the team's charter, users, and scale."}]},{"name":"Motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why the applicant wants this type of security engineering work at this stage of their career.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter states interest in the job with little explanation of why this work matters to the applicant."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gives a general reason for wanting backend or security work but does not build a distinctive career rationale."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter offers a plausible explanation for pursuing security platform work and links it to prior experience or values."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a clear and credible narrative for why this role is the applicant's next deliberate step."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a memorable and deeply convincing motivation rooted in specific experiences or a well-articulated professional philosophy that strongly matches the role."}]},{"name":"Experience depth","description":"The extent of professional experience the letter shows in testing, maintaining, launching, and owning production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only minimum-level professional experience with relatively narrow production scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows early-career production experience with limited system count or ownership breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid professional experience with multiple years in production software and credible responsibility for shipped systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial experience across several years or services, with clear end-to-end ownership of meaningful production work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep professional experience with long tenure and broad responsibility across multiple production systems."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Go as a language the applicant uses confidently for production back-end work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter identifies Go as a used language but gives no context, ownership, or signal that it is a real strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter says Go is a regular working language but offers only thin evidence of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter makes clear that Go is used routinely in the applicant's production work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a main language tied to meaningful back-end or infrastructure responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go a standout strength by linking it to design or operation of the kinds of security-relevant back-end systems this role requires."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Python as a meaningful production language for automation, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python or mentions it too vaguely to establish meaningful experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions some Python use but not in a way that suggests substantial ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular Python use for tooling, scripts, prototypes, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong Python experience across multiple production uses, especially automation or internal services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as deeply production-grade and central to automation, services, or agent work."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates practical strength with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of data structures or algorithmic ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims comfort with algorithms in general terms but offers no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one credible example of using better structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong algorithmic thinking through a clear and technically specific example with meaningful effect."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes algorithmic fluency feel like a standout strength, backed by specific redesigns or transformations of difficult problems."}]},{"name":"AI production","description":"How much hands-on experience the letter shows in shipping AI or LLM-backed features responsibly.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of hands-on AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI interest or exposure without clear production responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows direct experience shipping AI or LLM-backed functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows production AI work plus some attention to reliability, hardening, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows mature production AI experience in which trustworthy deployment, evaluation, and operational safeguards are central."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"How much concrete experience the letter shows in evaluating systems for security weaknesses.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of conducting security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references security reviews only vaguely or as a minor part of other work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows credible hands-on assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial assessment experience across different contexts, with clear method and follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents security assessment as a strong practiced capability, including structured analysis, attacker-minded review, and validation of remediation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How much ownership the letter shows over tooling that automates vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of work on vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions vulnerability response interest or minor exposure without clear ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows involvement in automating some part of vulnerability intake, triage, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes owning a meaningful vulnerability pipeline that reduced manual work for a team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong ownership of end-to-end vulnerability automation, such as classification, deduplication, routing, or other operational scaling of response work."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates experience designing agent-based systems with back-end control surfaces.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of designing agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents or automation in broad terms without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows credible involvement in building agent-based tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes clear architectural ownership for agent systems, including division of work between agents and services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents sophisticated agentic design with explicit attention to permissions, auditability, bounded actions, or supervision."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys habits of building trustworthy systems through guardrails, auditability, testing, evaluation, or explicit failure handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows no clear sign of reliability thinking beyond generic competence claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter states high standards or correctness in general terms without naming concrete mechanisms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one concrete sign of rigor, such as a maintainer's mindset, evaluation work, testing discipline, or bounded behavior."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows multiple concrete mechanisms for trustworthy behavior, such as audit logs, typed and tested tooling, guardrails, validated fixes, or careful failure-mode handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes rigorous and trustworthy engineering a central theme, repeatedly showing how safety and reliability are designed into systems rather than assumed."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames the candidate as someone who wants to build security tooling with organization-wide leverage.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mostly frames the role as a personal opportunity and gives little sense of interest in broad organizational impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at broader leverage but does not develop why foundational work appeals to the applicant."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values infrastructure or tooling that benefits more than one team."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly frames past work and future goals around scalable leverage across an organization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows a strong platform instinct, explicitly focusing on multiplying scarce security expertise or improving capacity across a large engineering ecosystem."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"How clearly the letter shows concern for making security tools useful, low-friction, and well aligned with the engineers they serve.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not show meaningful concern for how security tooling affects the engineers who use it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions helping others in passing but without a clear design stance toward usability or workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some awareness that good security tooling should reduce friction for its users."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter emphasizes building systems that make secure behavior easier for developer teams or other stakeholders."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a strong enablement philosophy, with concrete examples of making the secure path the default and staying close to the people served."}]},{"name":"Security initiative","description":"How much the letter shows self-driven security practice beyond normal job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of security engagement beyond normal job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows only a light extracurricular signal, such as casual interest or occasional practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a meaningful baseline signal, such as recurring CTF participation or an entry-level security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong extra-role security commitment, such as OSCP or sustained serious competition results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional security initiative beyond the day job by combining high-credibility offensive practice, advanced certification, or standout competition performance."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"How much self-directed technical work outside the main job the letter presents as evidence of curiosity and follow-through.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no meaningful evidence of self-directed technical work outside core job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small personal build or occasional upstream fix without much depth or sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a finished side project or regular open-source contribution that indicates real initiative."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a substantial personal system or maintained open-source project requiring sustained effort."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates exceptional self-driven technical ambition through an unusually demanding build or an externally used project with ongoing ownership."}]},{"name":"Evidence","description":"How well the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, ownership details, and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on assertions and buzzwords, with little concrete support for its claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specifics but leaves most major claims unsubstantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter supports several claims with concrete examples of work performed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter regularly pairs claims with specific examples, ownership details, or visible outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter builds a highly credible case through repeated concrete evidence, technical specificity, and clear results."}]},{"name":"Organization","description":"How clearly and persuasively the letter is structured from opening through closing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter feels disjointed or list-like enough that the overall case is hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a recognizable structure but uneven transitions or a weak sense of progression."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally clear and easy to follow from opening through closing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well structured, with a logical sequence that steadily builds the case for fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally coherent and well paced, turning the application into a persuasive narrative rather than a list of points."}]},{"name":"Mechanics","description":"How polished the sentence-level writing is in spelling, grammar, and surface correctness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent spelling, grammar, or formatting errors that distract throughout."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has multiple noticeable errors that reduce polish but do not obscure meaning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has some minor errors or awkward phrasing but remains professionally readable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is mostly polished, with only isolated minor mistakes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is essentially error-free and professionally polished."}]}]}
